title: Explosion and collapse of Aeon shopping center in Kumamoto leaves two dead and one seriously injured after earthquake
summary: Rescue teams work to search for possible victims while police release images of the interior of the collapsed building.

summary: The collapse of a chimney causes the evacuation of workers while emergency services search for those trapped.

summary: Seismologists point out that the magnitude 7.1 earthquake originated on an 'unbroken fault' of the 2016 earthquake and warn of the possibility of similar movements in the coming days.

summary: The government deploys more than 4,600 members of the Self-Defense Forces for rescue and infrastructure recovery efforts.

title: Road closures and suspension of Shinkansen in Kyushu after Kumamoto earthquake
summary: The Kyushu Expressway remains closed in several sections and the bullet train stops operating from early morning, affecting mobility in the region.

title: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake shakes Kumamoto prefecture with aftershocks and widespread damage
summary: The quake causes structural collapses, fires, and a tsunami warning that is later canceled, activating emergency protocols nationwide.

title: Kumamoto hospitals overwhelmed with more than 50 injured and multiple rescues after earthquake
summary: Medical centers treat dozens of people affected by the quake, while rescue operations continue in the most damaged areas.

title: Three dead and five people in cardiac arrest reported after magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Kumamoto
summary: Provincial authorities report that at least seven people are missing and about thirty have serious injuries.

title: Kumamoto earthquake affects semiconductor production and causes volatility in shares of local companies
summary: The disruption at electronics and paper factories generates uncertainty in the Japanese stock market.

title: Warning about dangerously high temperatures and risk of heat stroke in areas affected by the earthquake in Kumamoto
summary: Authorities recommend hydration and rest measures due to extreme heat in shelters and devastated areas.

title: Keiko Fujimori, of Japanese descent, assumes presidency of Peru with a reform agenda
summary: The right-wing leader faces economic and political challenges during her term, becoming the country's first female president.

title: Former baseball pitcher and TV personality Bando Eiji dies at 86
summary: Sports and entertainment figures pay tribute to the former star of the Chunichi Dragons and popular TV face.

title: Bribery scandal at Japan Post: employees received 100 million yen in favors from a steel company
summary: Prosecutors raid the postal company's offices and detain several involved in the irregular awarding of construction contracts.

title: Arrested for illegal collection of 8.5 million yen in organ trafficking case in Japan
summary: The investigation reveals that a repatriated patient was rejected by Japanese hospitals, while new aspects of the scandal are uncovered.

title: Social security spending in Japan reaches 138 trillion yen in 2024, second highest in history
summary: Despite the increase, the share of GDP continues to decline due to economic growth.

title: Yen trades at 163 yen to the dollar ahead of monetary policy decisions in Japan and the United States
summary: The foreign exchange market shows a trend of yen selling as traders adjust positions ahead of central bank meetings.

title: Nikkei index falls more than 1,100 points to 61,200 yen dragged by speculative selling

title: Takaichi government decides to reduce consumption tax on food to 1% for two years starting in April
summary: The measure generates debate in the ruling party and the opposition, while the prime minister seeks support from conservative sectors.

title: Approval of Takaichi government drops significantly, especially among conservatives, thirty-somethings, and housewives
summary: Dissatisfaction with the management of daily life and economic policy explains the loss of popular support.

title: Detailed summary of the Kumamoto earthquake: casualties, infrastructure damage, and impact on transportation
summary: Special reports compile the evolution of the tragedy, rescue efforts, and the impact on daily life in the prefecture.

title: Japanese government reinforces rescue operation with 4,600 Self-Defense Forces personnel
summary: Prime Minister Takaichi chairs the second meeting of the crisis cabinet to coordinate humanitarian aid and service restoration.

title: More than 34,000 households in Kumamoto remain without power after the earthquake
summary: Authorities work to restore electricity and communication services in the areas most affected by the quake.

title: Wall Street closes higher while crude oil falls below 80 dollars for first time in two weeks
